def corner_stats(a, p=48):
    out = []
    for P in (a[:p,:p], a[:p,-p:], a[-p:,:p], a[-p:,-p:]):
        P = P.reshape(-1,3).astype(np.float32)
        out.append(np.concatenate([P.mean(0), P.std(0)]))
    return np.array(out)  # TL,TR,BL,BR x 6
labS = lab[lab.S].reset_index(drop=True)

    st = corner_stats(load256(pid))
    top = np.abs(st[0]-st[1]).sum(); bot = np.abs(st[2]-st[3]).sum()
    scores.append(max(top, bot))
labS['mism'] = scores
print(labS.groupby('place').mism.describe())

def corner_tile2(a, p=48):
    def up(P): return np.asarray(Image.fromarray(P).resize((64,64), Image.BICUBIC))
    TL, TR, BL, BR = up(a[:p,:p]), up(a[:p,-p:]), up(a[-p:,:p]), up(a[-p:,-p:])
    def quad(P, corner):
        if corner[1]=='L': row = np.concatenate([P, P[:,::-1]],1)
        else: row = np.concatenate([P[:,::-1], P],1)
        return np.concatenate([row, row[::-1]],0) if corner[0]=='T' else np.concatenate([row[::-1], row],0)
    top = np.concatenate([quad(TL,'TL'), quad(TR,'TR')],1)
    bot = np.concatenate([quad(BL,'BL'), quad(BR,'BR')],1)
